verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भीमनिर्ह्रादं शक्राशनिसमस्वनम्।वीक्षमाणा दिशः सर्वा दुद्रुवुर्वानरर्षभाः ।। ६.८२.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu bhīmanirhrādaṁ śakrāśanisamasvanam।vīkṣamāṇā diśaḥ sarvā dudruvurvānararṣabhāḥ ।। 6.82.1 ।।

translations.english: The bulls among Vanaras heard the roar which was like thunder and looking at Indrajith fled in all directions.

verses.sloka: तानुवाच ततःसर्वान् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।विषण्णवदनान् दीनांस्त्रस्तान् विद्रवतः पृथक् ।। ६.८२.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tānuvāca tataḥsarvān hanumān mārutātmajaḥ।viṣaṇṇavadanān dīnāṁstrastān vidravataḥ pṛthak ।। 6.82.2 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Maruti's son, Hanuman said to all Vanaras who were looking sad, piteous, feeling singly out of fear, and running away.
translations.hindi: सुभोव ढ रा अपने भाई कुम्भ का मारा जाना देख, कुम्भ का .. भाई निकुम्भ क्रोध से जलता हुआ सा वानरराज को घूरने 0007 ॥ पै नय - “22 १-3... ; कट क्र हक! है नट सप्रसप्ततितमः सगः ८५६ ततः स्रग्दामसञ्नद्धं दत्तपश्चाङगुलं ¦ शुभम्‌ । आददे परिघं वीरो नगेन्द्रशिखरोपमम्‌

verses.sloka: कस्माद्विषण्णवदना विद्रवध्वे प्लवङ्गमाः।त्यक्तयुद्धसमुत्साहाः शूरत्वं क्वनु वो गतम् ।। ६.८२.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kasmādviṣaṇṇavadanā vidravadhve plavaṅgamāḥ।tyaktayuddhasamutsāhāḥ śūratvaṁ kvanu vo gatam ।। 6.82.3 ।।

translations.english: "O monkeys! Why have you lost enthusiasm to fight, looking sad and running away? Where has your valour gone?"
translations.hindi: डक पर सोने के पत्र मढ़े हुए थे और हीरा ओर मू रै जड़े हुए थे। वह यमराज के डंडे की तरह भयङ्कर था खोर रा्तसों का भय दूर करने वाला था

verses.sloka: पृष्ठतो ऽनुव्रजध्वं मामग्रतो यान्तमाहवे।शूरैरभिजनोपेतैरयुक्तं हि निवर्तितुम् ।। ६.८२.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhato 'nuvrajadhvaṁ māmagrato yāntamāhave।śūrairabhijanopetairayuktaṁ hi nivartitum ।। 6.82.4 ।।

translations.english: "Return and come in front, close to me and follow me. It is not proper for you to win wars and be praised."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ताः सुसंहृष्टा वायुपुत्रेण वानराः।शैलशृङ्गाण्यगांश्चैव जगृहुर्हृष्टमानसाः ।। ६.८२.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktāḥ susaṁhṛṣṭā vāyuputreṇa vānarāḥ।śailaśṛṅgāṇyagāṁścaiva jagṛhurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 6.82.5 ।।

translations.english: Wise son of wind god having spoken in that way, delighted in mind the Vanaras seized peaks of mountains and also trees in great fury.
translations.hindi: उसकी छाती के ऊपर हार झूल रहा था और उनकी भुजाओं पर बाजूत्रन्द शोभित हो रहे थे । उसके कानों में विचित्र कुण्डल थे श्रौर वह गले में विचित्र अर्थात्‌ बहुत बढ़िया माला पहिने हुए था

verses.sloka: अभिपेतुश्च गर्जन्तो राक्षसान् वानरर्षभाः।परिवार्य हनूमन्तमन्वयुश्च महाहवे ।। ६.८२.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhipetuśca garjanto rākṣasān vānararṣabhāḥ।parivārya hanūmantamanvayuśca mahāhave ।। 6.82.6 ।।

translations.english: Surrounding Hanuman, the Vanara leaders followed him for a great fight.
translations.hindi: उस समय वह निकुम्भ उन आभूषणों और उस परिष से एसा शोभायमान हो रहा था, जैसे कड़कड़ाती हुई बिजली और इन्द्रधनुष सहित गड़गड़ाता हुआ बादल

verses.sloka: स तैर्वानरमुख्यैश्च हनुमान् सर्वतो वृतः।हुताशन इवार्चिष्मानदहच्छत्रुवाहिनीम् ।। ६.८२.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tairvānaramukhyaiśca hanumān sarvato vṛtaḥ।hutāśana ivārciṣmānadahacchatruvāhinīm ।। 6.82.7 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman went surrounded by Vanara leaders who resembled flaming fire and began to consume the enemy troops like flaming fire.
translations.hindi: निकुम्भ का वह्‌ परिव इतना लंबा था कि वह जब उसे ऊपर उदाता था तब उसकी ऊपर की नोंक से टकरा कर आवाइ प्रवाह आदि पवन की सातों गाँठे' खुल जाती थीं और बिना धुर की आग भभक उठतो थी अर्थात्‌ उससे आग की लपटें निकलने -लगती थीं

verses.sloka: स राक्षसानां कदनं चकार सुमहाकपिः।वृतो वानरसैन्येन कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.८२.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rākṣasānāṁ kadanaṁ cakāra sumahākapiḥ।vṛto vānarasainyena kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।। 6.82.8 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara army surrounded that great monkey, Hanuman, who was like Yama, the god of death and caused havoc to Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: स तु कोपेन चाविष्टः शोकेन च महाकपिः।हनुमान् रावणिरथे ऽपातयन्महतीं शिलाम् ।। ६.८२.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu kopena cāviṣṭaḥ śokena ca mahākapiḥ।hanumān rāvaṇirathe 'pātayanmahatīṁ śilām ।। 6.82.9 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, overtaken by anger, filled with great sorrow hurled a huge rock at the chariot of Ravana's son.

verses.sloka: तामापतन्तीं दृष्ट्वैव रथः सारथिना तदा।विधेयाश्वसमायुक्तः सुदूरमपवाहितः ।। ६.८२.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmāpatantīṁ dṛṣṭvaiva rathaḥ sārathinā tadā।vidheyāśvasamāyuktaḥ sudūramapavāhitaḥ ।। 6.82.10 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing that rock coming towards the chariot yoked to obedient horses, the chariot rider drove it to a long distance.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--नक्षत्र, तारा, ग्रह, चन्द्र आदि का नाम लेकर भी सूय का नाम यहा इसलिए नहीं लिञ्रा गया कि, जित समय की यह घटना है- उस समय रात का समय था। ] दुरासदश्च संजज्ञे परिघाभरणप्रभः । कपीनां स निकुम्भा श्नियंगान्तायि रिवोत्थितः

verses.sloka: तमिन्द्रजितमप्राप्य रथस्थं सहसारथिम्।विवेशधरणीं भित्त्वा सा शिला व्यर्थमुद्यता ।। ६.८२.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamindrajitamaprāpya rathasthaṁ sahasārathim।viveśadharaṇīṁ bhittvā sā śilā vyarthamudyatā ।। 6.82.11 ।।

translations.english: That rock hurled by Hanuman failed to reach the chariot in which Indrajith was seated and also the charioteer. It cleaved the earth and entered.
translations.hindi: उस समयन तो कोई राक्षस ओर न कोई वानर ही ( अपनी- जगह से ) हिल सकता था। किन्तु बलवान हनुमान जी अपनी छाती फुला कर उसके सामने जा खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: पातितायां शिलायां तु रक्षसां व्यथिता चमूः।निपतन्त्या च शिलया राक्षसा मथिता भृशम् ।। ६.८२.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: pātitāyāṁ śilāyāṁ tu rakṣasāṁ vyathitā camūḥ।nipatantyā ca śilayā rākṣasā mathitā bhṛśam ।। 6.82.12 ।।

translations.english: As the rock fell on the battlefield the Rakshasa troops got alarmed and were violently crushed to death.
translations.hindi: प परिघ के तुल्य बाहु वाले बलवान्‌ वीर कुम्भ ने सूये के समान प्रभावाले परिघ को हनुमान्‌ जी की छाती में मारा

verses.sloka: तमभ्यधावञ्छतशो नदन्तः काननौकसः ।। ६.८२.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamabhyadhāvañchataśo nadantaḥ kānanaukasaḥ ।। 6.82.13 ।।

translations.english: Those gigantic forest dwellers in hundreds seizing trees and rocks lifted and fought making loud noise.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे हनुमान्‌ जी की विशाल छाती से टकरा कर, उस परिघ के खौ टुकड़े हो गए और वे प्रथिवी पर ऐसे बिखर गये, मानों सौ उल्का आकाश से टूट कर गिरे हों

verses.sloka: ते द्रुमांश्च महावीर्या गिरिशृङ्गाणि चोद्यताः।क्षिपन्तीन्द्रजितः सङ्ख्ये वानरा भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.८२.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: te drumāṁśca mahāvīryā giriśṛṅgāṇi codyatāḥ।kṣipantīndrajitaḥ saṅkhye vānarā bhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.82.14 ।।

translations.english: Courageous Vanaras, innumerable in number began to rain trees and rocks throwing on the enemies. The Rakshasas number rolled on the battlefield shouting in numerous tones.
translations.hindi: भूडोल होने पर जैसे पवत अचल रहता हे, वैसे द्दी हनुमान जी परिघ के प्रहार से भी अटल अचल खडे रहे

verses.sloka: वृक्षशैलमहावर्षं विसृजन्तः प्लवङ्गमाः।शत्रूणां कदनं चक्रुर्नेदुश्च विविधैः स्वरैः ।। ६.८२.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣaśailamahāvarṣaṁ visṛjantaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।śatrūṇāṁ kadanaṁ cakrurneduśca vividhaiḥ svaraiḥ ।। 6.82.15 ।।

translations.english: Night rangers of dreadful appearance beaten up with trees by most fierce Vanaras, fell on the battlefield and struck one another.

verses.sloka: वानरैस्तैर्महावीर्यैर्घोररूपा निशाचराः।वीर्यादभिहता वृक्षैर्व्यवेष्टन्त रणाजिरे ।। ६.८२.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānaraistairmahāvīryairghorarūpā niśācarāḥ।vīryādabhihatā vṛkṣairvyaveṣṭanta raṇājire ।। 6.82.16 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, looking at his own army tormented by the Vanaras, was enraged, and went towards the enemies' seizing weapons.
translations.hindi: जिसकी चोट से उसकी खाल फट गई “और लोहू बहने लगा तथा एक ज्वाला ऐसी भभकी, जैसे वादल में बिजली कौंधती तेन प्रहारेण निकुम्भो बिचचाल ह। करय्पिःनि निजग्राह -हलुमन्तं^ मस्सन्रलम्‌

verses.sloka: स्वसैन्यमभिवीक्ष्याथ वानरार्दितमिन्द्रजित्।प्रगृहीतायुधः क्रुद्धः परानभिमुखो ययौ ।। ६.८२.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: svasainyamabhivīkṣyātha vānarārditamindrajit।pragṛhītāyudhaḥ kruddhaḥ parānabhimukho yayau ।। 6.82.17 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith of unyielding valour, combining with his own army let go numerous arrows on the tigers of Vanaras and struck them.

verses.sloka: स शरौघानवसृजन् स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः।जघान कपिशार्दूलान् स बहून् दृष्टविक्रमः ।। ६.८२.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śaraughānavasṛjan svasainyenābhisaṁvṛtaḥ।jaghāna kapiśārdūlān sa bahūn dṛṣṭavikramaḥ ।। 6.82.18 ।।

translations.english: In the battle, followers of Indrajith struck the Vanaras with tridents, asanis, swords, sharp edged spears, and kutamudgaras.

verses.sloka: शूलैरशनिभिः खड्गैः पट्टिशैः कूटमुद्गरैः।ते चाप्यनुचरास्तस्य वानरान् जघ्नुरोजसा ।। ६.८२.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: śūlairaśanibhiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ।te cāpyanucarāstasya vānarān jaghnurojasā ।। 6.82.19 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, who was endowed with great strength, killed Rakshasas capable of terrific tasks with trees having large trunks and branches and stones also.

verses.sloka: सस्कन्धविटपैः सालैः शिलाभिश्च महाबलः।हनुमान् कदनं चक्रे रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् ।। ६.८२.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: saskandhaviṭapaiḥ sālaiḥ śilābhiśca mahābalaḥ।hanumān kadanaṁ cakre rakṣasāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।। 6.82.20 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman made the enemy army retreat, and spoke to his own army," No use of defeating this army for us as our mission is not winning the army."

verses.sloka: स निवार्य परानीकमब्रवीत्तान् वनौकसः।हनुमान् सन्निवर्तध्वं न नः साध्यमिदं बलम् ।। ६.८२.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa nivārya parānīkamabravīttān vanaukasaḥ।hanumān sannivartadhvaṁ na naḥ sādhyamidaṁ balam ।। 6.82.21 ।।

translations.english: "To please Rama, we are giving up life. Let us make Rama know that the daughter of Janaka for whose sake we are fighting this war and giving up life has been killed."
translations.hindi: पवननन्दन हनुमान जी उसी समय अपने को राक्षस के ह।थ से छुटा ओर कूद कर प्रथिवी पर जा खड़े हुए और फिर निकुम्भ को ( अपने काबू में कर ) खूब रगड़ा

verses.sloka: त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् विवेष्टन्तो रामिप्रियचिकीर्षवः।यन्निमित्तं हि युद्ध्यामो हता सा जनकात्मजा ।। ६.८२.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā prāṇān viveṣṭanto rāmipriyacikīrṣavaḥ।yannimittaṁ hi yuddhyāmo hatā sā janakātmajā ।। 6.82.22 ।।

translations.english: "On telling this fact (that Indrajith has killed Sita) to Rama and Sugriva and knowing their reply we will do what is to be done."

verses.sloka: इममर्थं हि विज्ञाप्य रामं सुग्रीवमेव च।तौ यत् प्रतिविधास्येते तत् करिष्यामहे वयम् ।। ६.८२.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: imamarthaṁ hi vijñāpya rāmaṁ sugrīvameva ca।tau yat pratividhāsyete tat kariṣyāmahe vayam ।। 6.82.23 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of the Vanaras, kept back all the Vanaras after speaking that way to the army and slowly and slowly retreated.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा वानरश्रेष्ठो वारयन् सर्ववानरान्।शनैः शनैरसंत्रस्तः सबलः सन्न्यवर्तत ।। ६.८२.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā vānaraśreṣṭho vārayan sarvavānarān।śanaiḥ śanairasaṁtrastaḥ sabalaḥ sannyavartata ।। 6.82.24 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, observing Hanuman going to Raghava, the evil minded Indrajith went to Nikumbhilam desiring to offer oblations at the sanctuary.
translations.hindi: इस तरह जब हनुमान जी ने उस चिल्लाते हुए निकुम्भ को मार डाला, तब दशरथनन्द्न श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ओर खरपुत्र मकराक्ष का अत्यन्त क्रोध में भर, बड़ा भयङ्कर युद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: ततः प्रेक्ष्य हनूमन्तं व्रजन्तं यत्र राघवः।स होतुकामो दुष्टात्मा गतश्चैत्यनिकुम्भिलाम् ।। ६.८२.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prekṣya hanūmantaṁ vrajantaṁ yatra rāghavaḥ।sa hotukāmo duṣṭātmā gataścaityanikumbhilām ।। 6.82.25 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith reaching Nikumbhilam, the sacrificial ground, poured oblation of blood into the sacrificial fire for Devatas and the fire blazed.

verses.sloka: निकुम्भिलामधिष्ठाय पावकं जुहवेन्द्रजित् ।। ६.८२.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: nikumbhilāmadhiṣṭhāya pāvakaṁ juhavendrajit ।। 6.82.26 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith reaching Nikumbhilam, the sacrificial ground, poured oblation of blood into the sacrificial fire for Devatas and the fire blazed.

verses.sloka: यज्ञभूम्यां तु विधिवत् पावकस्तेन रक्षसा।हूयमानः प्रजज्वाल मांसशोणितभुक् तदा ।। ६.८२.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: yajñabhūmyāṁ tu vidhivat pāvakastena rakṣasā।hūyamānaḥ prajajvāla māṁsaśoṇitabhuk tadā ।। 6.82.27 ।।

translations.english: The flame had swollen up with the offering of blood as oblation and risen. It was very bright and wrapped in the flames the fire resembled the sun.

verses.sloka: सो ऽर्चिःपिनद्धो ददृशे होमशोणिततर्पितः।सन्ध्यागत इवादित्यः सुतीव्रो ऽग्निः समुत्थितः ।। ६.८२.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'rciḥpinaddho dadṛśe homaśoṇitatarpitaḥ।sandhyāgata ivādityaḥ sutīvro 'gniḥ samutthitaḥ ।। 6.82.28 ।।

translations.english: Then Indrajit, for the prosperity of the rakshasas, duly offered oblations according to rite; and beholding it, those rakshasas, knowing right policy from wrong, stood firm in their vast ranks.

verses.sloka: अथेन्द्रजिद्राक्षसभूतये तु जुहाव हव्यं विधिना विधानवित्।दृष्ट्वा व्यतिष्ठन्त च राक्षसास्ते महासमूहेषु नयानयज्ञाः ।। ६.८२.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: athendrajidrākṣasabhūtaye tu juhāva havyaṁ vidhinā vidhānavit।dṛṣṭvā vyatiṣṭhanta ca rākṣasāste mahāsamūheṣu nayānayajñāḥ ।। 6.82.29 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्व्यशीततमः सर्गः ।। ८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe dvyaśītatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 82 ।।
